# Uncut gem item texts (TC-UNCUT-GEM)

SYNTHETIC. No live Ctrl+C text of an uncut gem was in the tree or its
fixtures, and the forum is not a permitted source (decision 0050), so
these files are AshLight-authored in the item-text structure the item
parser handles (an "Item Class:" header, "Rarity: Currency", the name
line, "--------" sections). The name lines and the description and
direction lines are the cached repoe-fork base_items snapshot's own
strings for those bases (`Uncut Skill Gem (Level 10)`, `Creates a Skill
Gem or Level an existing gem to level 10`, `Uncut Support Gem (Level 3)`,
`Creates a Support Gem`, `Uncut Spirit Gem (Level 14)`, ...). The
"Item Class:" display words are assumed. `uncut_skill_prop_5.txt` is the
alternate shape with the level as a `Level: N` property. When a dev-host
press sample (decision 0045 amendment) captures a live uncut gem, it
replaces these files (decision 0094).
